description: Remove the background of an image with AI; the result is a PNG with transparency. Costs 1 credit per run, refunded if it fails. Needs a CropDen API key. Input: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB and 2048 px on the longest side. Returns a link to the result, valid 7 days.

image_base64.description: The image as base64 (a data: URL is fine). Use instead of image_url for local files.

image_url.description: Public https URL of a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.

name: ai_remove_background
title: Remove background
